text:
Look at your call log for one week. Count the missed calls after 7 pm.

For most local businesses, evening is when customers finally have time to call. It's also when the owner is closing up, driving home, or with family.

Those calls don't come back. The customer just dials the next number on Google.

The fix takes an afternoon:
1. Every missed call gets an automatic WhatsApp message within a minute: "We're closed right now. Tell us what you need and we'll call you first thing at 10 am."
2. Half the callers type their need. Now you have a written lead instead of a lost one.
3. At 10 am the team gets one list: everyone who called after hours, oldest first.

You don't need a call centre. You need the first reply to be instant, even when nobody is there.

How many missed calls did you have last week?
